fast.change: Implemented API calls to OpenAI endpoints to fetch model outputs and model lists.
fast.impact: Enables integration with OpenAI services for text generation and model discovery.

detailed.change: The function now performs a POST request to a specific OpenAI completions-style endpoint and a GET request to the models catalog. It includes header authorization, dynamic payload construction using provided parameters, and nested response parsing to extract text content and data lists respectively.
detailed.impact: This updates the system to interact with external OpenAI infrastructure. The function now dictates how inputs are serialized and how error states from the provider are communicated back to the caller, effectively acting as a client adapter for OpenAI services.
detailed.risk: The hardcoded endpoint URL (v1/responses) does not match standard OpenAI official API endpoints, potentially causing integration failures. There is no validation for the API key format or the response structure schema, making the system prone to runtime errors if the external contract changes. risk: medium
